title: CX Mesh 2.0.0-1 — retire cx-node commands, account and paths
notes: Verified committed-main package and seven migration acceptance scenarios. Replaces cx-node local commands, service account and paths with cx-mesh, preserving numeric UID/GID, owner configuration, identity, credentials and state. No compatibility command aliases. Protected publication also verifies historical DPKG residual upgrades with the production AGPC guard. Signed AGPC activation and live-host readiness are separate.
